intent.logline_zh: 赛博朋克少女穿过霓虹都市，停步抬头，眼神从迷茫转坚定。

characters.desc_zh: 十几岁少女，银色齐耳短发，打补丁的机能夹克，全程不说话

invariants.setting_zh: 雨夜赛博朋克都市街道，霓虹招牌密集

beats.what_zh: 少女低头穿过人群，相机侧跟
少女停步抬头直视前方，推近

risks: 原文300字企划已压缩：身世隐喻与三幕情绪只保留迷茫到坚定，其余是分镜与剪辑的工作，不进单条 prompt

pe.integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Stylized cyberpunk night city, rain-slicked streets under dense neon signage. A teenage girl with silver bob hair and a patched techwear jacket drifts through the crowd with lowered gaze as the camera tracks beside her at slow speed. [Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a slow push in on her face as she stops, lifts her chin and stares ahead with hardened resolve.
pe.overall_soundscape: Steady rain, muffled crowd murmur and footsteps on wet pavement.
